name: Los Angeles Rams
status: Phase B job d8 (2026-09-23). Colours sourced (team_colors_official_2026.json); 2026 primary set from the Rams' 2026 unveil; placements INFERRED and checked with 3D previews. u7 (2026-09-24): see U7_RAMS_2026-09-24.md.

roster.defense_note: ESPN's 2026 chart: NT, LDE, RDE, LILB, RILB, WLB, SLB (a 3-4): ends to the interior pool, outside backers to EDGE.

faces.note: 2K5 skin tone 0 (lightest) to 5 (darkest), set by eye from the official 2026 headshots against the Giants pilot's calibration (INFERRED); the automatic cheek estimate reads studio-lit darker skin as light, so it is kept only as skin_lab in faces.json. Dreads (locs, long twists) by eye. Hair colours set by eye where the automatic sample read the backdrop between locs or a shadow (first contact sheet, 2026-09-23).

home.note: 2026 royal primary: royal jersey, sol shoulder yoke, royal sleeve caps with a sol horn, solid sol numbers (2020 font), sol pants with a white-royal-white stripe, royal socks, royal helmet with the sol horn

away.note: 2026 white primary: white jersey, sol shoulder yoke, royal sleeve caps with a sol horn, solid royal numbers, white pants with a sol-royal-sol stripe, royal socks, royal helmet

cs_home.note: 2026 Classic Sol alternate (style 10; therams.com 2026-07-23): sol jersey, royal block numbers (no outline), royal three-stripe sleeves (thin-thick-thin), royal neck tag with the sol LA, white pants with a royal-sol-royal stripe, white socks, the regular royal helmet with the sol horn and classic block bumper lettering

cs_away.note: 2026 Classic Sol alternate (style 10; therams.com 2026-07-23): sol jersey, royal block numbers (no outline), royal three-stripe sleeves (thin-thick-thin), royal neck tag with the sol LA, white pants with a royal-sol-royal stripe, white socks, the regular royal helmet with the sol horn and classic block bumper lettering

fw_home.note: 2026 Fearsome White alternate (style 11; therams.com 2026-07-23): white jersey, a continuous royal shoulder stripe with a midnight trim, royal block numbers with a thin midnight outline on the chest, back and sleeves (TV numbers), midnight name letters, royal neck tag with the white LA, white pants with a royal stripe trimmed in midnight, white socks, royal helmet with white horns, white facemask

fw_away.note: 2026 Fearsome White alternate (style 11; therams.com 2026-07-23): white jersey, a continuous royal shoulder stripe with a midnight trim, royal block numbers with a thin midnight outline on the chest, back and sleeves (TV numbers), midnight name letters, royal neck tag with the white LA, white pants with a royal stripe trimmed in midnight, white socks, royal helmet with white horns, white facemask

mr_home.note: Midnight Rivalry (Nike and NFL Rivalries, 2025-2027; style 12; therams.com 2025-08-28): matte midnight jersey, royal sleeve caps fading to midnight through halftone dots with the sol horn curl and a white swoosh, white numbers (2020 font) with a thin royal outline, white name letters, midnight pants with a sol and a royal stripe, midnight socks, matte midnight helmet with the sol horn and a dark facemask

mr_away.note: Midnight Rivalry (Nike and NFL Rivalries, 2025-2027; style 12; therams.com 2025-08-28): matte midnight jersey, royal sleeve caps fading to midnight through halftone dots with the sol horn curl and a white swoosh, white numbers (2020 font) with a thin royal outline, white name letters, midnight pants with a sol and a royal stripe, midnight socks, matte midnight helmet with the sol horn and a dark facemask

venue.notes: Rams home games stay at the retail St. Louis dome (Noah: keep the same stadiums); only the team art changes. End zones: Rams royal with the white 2020 RAMS wordmark and sol LA logos (SoFi look; INFERRED). Midfield: the LA logo in full colour. Wall and tarp: the LA logo and RAMS wordmark replace the St. Louis marks; fan banners with 2026 players.

sources_uw.kit_2026: u7's 2026 Rams spec (U7_RAMS_2026-09-24.md; research copy u1/teams/LAR/spec.json, the kit the league projects v3 to v56 are built from): therams.com 'Los Angeles Rams unveil uniform & brand refresh ahead of 2026 season' (2026-04-16) and its unveil gallery, sportslogos.net (2026-04-16), therams.com's 2026 jersey schedule (2026-09-01) and 2026 game galleries; carried into the repo by uw (2026-09-29).
